name: Agent orchestrator
short_description: The component of an AI agent that reads a user's request, matches its intent against the names and descriptions of available skills and tools, and decides what to load into context for each turn.

evidence.quote: reusable, on-demand instruction sets that the orchestrator loads only when needed.
right now there's a concept that is called orchestrator minion
An orchestrator agent has a list of known agent URLs
The orchestrator does not execute the tasks. It routes work and merges results
